Validar sessão
query:
WITH touched AS (
  UPDATE user_sessions
  SET last_activity = NOW()
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.sessionId }}'::uuid
    AND user_id = '{{ $json.userId }}'::uuid
    AND revoked = FALSE
    AND expires_at > NOW()
  RETURNING id, user_id, expires_at
)
SELECT
  s.id AS "sessionId",
  u.id AS "userId",
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.sector_id AS "sectorId",
  sec.name AS "sectorName",
  u.active,
  u.is_master AS "isMaster",
  s.expires_at AS "expiresAt",
  CASE
    WHEN u.is_master = TRUE THEN (
      SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(p_all.code ORDER BY p_all.name), '[]'::json)
      FROM permissions p_all WHERE p_all.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    )
    ELSE COALESCE((
      SELECT json_agg(p.code ORDER BY p.code)
      FROM user_permissions up
      JOIN permissions p ON p.id = up.permission_id
      WHERE up.user_id = u.id AND p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    ), '[]'::json)
  END AS permissions
FROM touched s
JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
LEFT JOIN sectors sec ON sec.id = u.sector_id
WHERE u.active = TRUE;
